Use `snl entry relationships` to query graph relationships adjacent to one Entry.

### Agent procedure
1. Choose `--direction incoming`, `outgoing`, or `both` according to the question.
2. Treat relationship IDs and endpoints as exact identities, then retrieve any relationship that will drive a mutation.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl entry relationships` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
